<style id="nx-mo">
.nx-anim .nx-r{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) var(--nd,0ms),transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) var(--nd,0ms);animation:none!important}
.nx-anim .nx-r.nx-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.nx-glow{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s ease;background:radial-gradient(380px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),rgba(212,80,63,.13),transparent 46%);z-index:0}
.nx-sp:hover>.nx-glow{opacity:1}
.nx-bar{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-6px;height:2px;width:0;background:#D4503F;border-radius:2px;transition:width .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) .2s}
.nx-in .nx-bar,.nx-bar.on{width:42px}
@keyframes nxfloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.nx-float{animation:nxfloat 6s ease-in-out infinite}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.nx-anim .nx-r{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;transition:none!important}.nx-glow,.nx-float{display:none;animation:none}}
</style>

<script id="nx-mo-js">(function(){var d=document,R=d.documentElement;
if(window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return;
var P=null,fe=null;try{fe=window.frameElement;if(fe&&window.parent&&window.parent.innerHeight)P=window.parent}catch(e){P=null;fe=null}
var sel='.card,.fg,.vi,.lg,.gm,.tw,.cd,.po,.wk,.vd,.pj,.figs>*,.grid>*,.cards>*';
var all=[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll(sel));var els=all.filter(function(el){var p=el.parentElement;return !(p&&p.closest&&p.closest(sel))});
R.classList.add('nx-anim');
var o0=0,h0=innerHeight;try{o0=fe?fe.getBoundingClientRect().top:0;h0=P?P.innerHeight:innerHeight}catch(e){}
els=[];
var sy=0;try{sy=P?P.scrollY:0}catch(e){}
if(P&&sy>40){[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('.rv')).forEach(function(el){var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(o0+r.top<h0+40){el.style.animation='none';el.style.opacity='1'}})}
els=els.filter(function(el){var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return o0+r.top>h0+40});
els.forEach(function(el){var p=el.parentElement,i=p?[].indexOf.call(p.children,el):0;el.style.setProperty('--nd',Math.min(i,4)*70+'ms');el.classList.add('nx-r')});
var nums=[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('.nums b,.stats b,.st b')).filter(function(b){return /^\s*[\d.,]+/.test(b.textContent)});
nums.forEach(function(b){b.dataset.t=b.textContent});
function count(b){if(b.dataset.c)return;b.dataset.c=1;var t=b.dataset.t,m=t.match(/^(\s*)([\d.,]+)([\s\S]*)$/);if(!m)return;var raw=m[2].replace(/,/g,''),v=parseFloat(raw),dec=(raw.split('.')[1]||'').length,comma=/,/.test(m[2]),s=performance.now(),D=1300;
function f(n){var x=n.toFixed(dec);return comma?Number(x).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:dec}):x}
(function st(now){var k=Math.min(1,(now-s)/D),e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3);b.textContent=m[1]+f(v*e)+m[3];if(k<1)requestAnimationFrame(st);else b.textContent=t})(s)}
function vh(){try{return P?P.innerHeight:innerHeight}catch(e){return innerHeight}}
function off(){try{return fe?fe.getBoundingClientRect().top:0}catch(e){return 0}}
var left=els.length;
function tick(){var o=off(),h=vh();els.forEach(function(el){if(el.dataset.v)return;var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(o+r.top<h*.9&&o+r.bottom>0){el.dataset.v=1;left--;el.classList.add('nx-in');setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('nx-r','nx-in');el.style.removeProperty('--nd')},1400)}});
nums.forEach(function(b){var r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(o+r.top<h*.95&&o+r.bottom>0)count(b)})}
var raf=0;function on(){if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){raf=0;tick()})}
try{var W=P||window;W.addEventListener('scroll',on,{passive:true});W.addEventListener('resize',on)}catch(e){}
tick();setTimeout(tick,250);setTimeout(tick,900);
setTimeout(function(){if(!P){els.forEach(function(el){el.classList.remove('nx-r')});nums.forEach(count)}},60);
var fine=window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches;
if(fine){[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('.card,.cd,.gm,.fg,.vi,.po,.wk,.lg-end')).forEach(function(c){if(getComputedStyle(c).position==='static')c.style.position='relative';var g=d.createElement('i');g.className='nx-glow';g.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');c.insertBefore(g,c.firstChild);c.classList.add('nx-sp')});
d.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){var c=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.nx-sp');if(!c)return;var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--mx',(e.clientX-r.left)+'px');c.style.setProperty('--my',(e.clientY-r.top)+'px')},{passive:true});}
[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('.head h2,.lg .lh h2')).forEach(function(h){if(getComputedStyle(h).position==='static')h.style.position='relative';var s=d.createElement('span');s.className='nx-bar';s.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');h.appendChild(s);setTimeout(function(){s.classList.add('on')},50)});
[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('.bh .nx,.gstack')).forEach(function(x){x.classList.add('nx-float')});
})();</script>
